Produced by Warrior, this Clear Whey Isolate delivers a lighter fruity twist to the classic protein milkshake of the past. Perfect for when you need a fast protein hit without that bloaty feeling, Warrior Clear Whey Isolate is sippable and drinkable like a normal fruit juice. Using only the purest of whey isolates, servings of 25-grams are 90% protein (22.56-grams to be precise), come virtually sugar-free and are super low in calories, fats and carbs. It's a fruit flavoured protein masterstroke. 375g = 15 servings 25g = 1 serving Ingredients Ingredients: Ultra-Pure WHEY Protein Isolate (MILK), Flavours, Colourings, Sweeteners (Sucralose, Ace-K). For allergens, see ingredients in uppercase. The ingredients list and allergens are based on the Blue Raspberry Warrior Clear Whey Isolate and may vary slightly to other flavours. Regulated Name: Whey protein supplement with sweetener.
